## Shipped Production Systems & Portfolios

1. **Ting AI** (https://app.tingsai.my.id)
   - Role: Founding Engineer & Full-Stack Architect
   - Description: AI thinking partner & portfolio risk engine for retail stock investors. Deterministic portfolio math in TypeScript paired with Gemini Pro structured reasoning schemas for macro/risk analysis.
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Gemini Pro, Supabase PostgreSQL, Edge Functions.

2. **Universitas Primagraha Main Portal & PMB** (https://primagraha.ac.id)
   - Role: Lead Web Developer
   - Description: Official university institutional portal and student admission ecosystem serving 10,000+ monthly visitors with Next.js ISR and sub-second page delivery.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, SIAKAD Integration.

3. **OPAC Perpustakaan Universitas Primagraha** (https://opac.upg.ac.id)
   - Role: Full-Stack Developer & System Owner
   - Description: Online Public Access Catalog indexing 3,070 book titles and 5,751 physical copies with 51,200+ digital visits.
   - Stack: PHP, SLiMS, MySQL, Windows IIS, PM2.

4. **LPM Universitas Primagraha** (https://lpm.primagraha.ac.id)
   - Role: Full-Stack Developer & System Owner
   - Description: Quality Assurance Institute portal uniting SPMI, SPME, Accreditation, AMI, and campus satisfaction surveys.
   - Stack: Node.js, Web Portal, Windows IIS.

5. **LPPM Universitas Primagraha** (https://lppm.primagraha.ac.id)
   - Role: Full-Stack Developer & System Owner
   - Description: Research and Community Service Institute portal with real-time research statistics, publication & HKI trackers.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Windows IIS.

6. **Open Library Universitas Primagraha** (https://perpus.primagraha.ac.id)
   - Role: Full-Stack Developer & System Owner
   - Description: Central library gateway providing federated search across 128,450 physical & digital collections with SSO authentication.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, SSO Authentication, OJS Integration.

7. **Rajawali Prestige** (https://rajawaliprestige.my.id)
   - Role: Independent Full-Stack Developer
   - Description: Avian competition and national community arena portal with interactive schedules and catalog.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.

8. **Central Jual Emas** (https://central-jual-emas.netlify.app)
